payload.criterion: plugin.json declares adaptive-artifacts in dependencies and marketplace.json lists both plugins with AA via github source; claude plugin validate . exits 0
payload.verify_command: claude plugin validate . && python3 -c "import json;p=json.load(open('.claude-plugin/plugin.json'));d=p.get('dependencies',[]);assert 'adaptive-artifacts' in d or any(isinstance(x,dict) and x.get('name')=='adaptive-artifacts' for x in d);m=json.load(open('.claude-plugin/marketplace.json'));assert {x.get('name') for x in m['plugins']}>= {'se-workflow','adaptive-artifacts'}"
